statusDetail: Atomic coverage complete across 58/58 checks and five representative paths.

paths.description: Homepage and breaking-news listing; representative primary entry and densest template.
Güncel category listing; representative section/index template.
Current news story; representative article/detail and reading journey.
Unknown route; representative HTTP failure and recovery state.

findings.summary: Core Web Vitals are poor on primary templates.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse measured homepage LCP 9.3s and CLS 0.38; article LCP was 19.4s with 550ms TBT.
findings.suggestedFix: Prioritize the LCP asset, reduce third-party startup work, reserve space, and retest each template against good CWV thresholds.

findings.summary: Transport protections and cookie attributes are unsafe.
findings.evidence: Headers found no CSP or HSTS; cookie audit found all 33 cookies flagged, including 30 without Secure and pervasive SameSite=None; article Lighthouse found one insecure request.
findings.suggestedFix: Add HSTS and a restrictive CSP, remove mixed content, and set Secure plus appropriate SameSite/HttpOnly attributes.

findings.summary: The page has an excessive tracking and third-party data footprint.
findings.evidence: Tracker capture found 35 third-party origins and five known tracker domains; the consent copy names 619 partners and HAR shows 149 requests.
findings.suggestedFix: Reduce vendors to the minimum needed, block all optional requests before consent, batch analytics, and document each retained processor.

findings.summary: Browser-enforced defensive policies are absent.
findings.evidence: The header audit found no frame protection, X-Content-Type-Options, Referrer-Policy or Permissions-Policy, in addition to missing CSP and HSTS.
findings.suggestedFix: Deploy frame-ancestors, nosniff, strict Referrer-Policy and least-privilege Permissions-Policy alongside CSP/HSTS.

findings.summary: A full-screen consent interstitial blocks every audited page on first load.
findings.evidence: Mobile screenshots of the homepage, article and currency utility show the consent dialog obscuring all primary content before interaction.
findings.suggestedFix: Use a compact, content-preserving consent treatment where legally permitted, keep reject and accept equally prominent, and defer non-essential vendors until choice.

findings.summary: Keyboard focus is invisible and multiple controls have small hit areas.
findings.evidence: Programmatic focus on the first link produced outline:none and no box-shadow; the probe listed many 15–20px-high links.
findings.suggestedFix: Provide a strong :focus-visible indicator and make interactive target boxes at least 24px, preferably 44px for touch.

findings.summary: The homepage shifts substantially after load.
findings.evidence: The mobile layout observer measured CLS 0.391, including a single 0.38675 shift; Lighthouse independently measured 0.38.
findings.suggestedFix: Reserve dimensions for late banners, consent/ad slots, images and fonts; identify and eliminate the 0.38675 shift source.

findings.summary: Heavy JavaScript blocks the main thread.
findings.evidence: The trace recorded a 997ms long task and 947ms TBT; Lighthouse reported 18.5s main-thread work on the homepage.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove or defer non-essential scripts, split long tasks, and schedule lower-priority work after the core content is interactive.

findings.summary: Resource delivery is heavy and includes render-blocking and weak-cache opportunities.
findings.evidence: HAR recorded 149 requests and 3.59MB transferred; Lighthouse estimated 540–1180ms render-blocking savings and 513–890KiB cache savings.
findings.suggestedFix: Shorten critical chains, set durable cache headers for immutable assets, preload only the LCP resource, and defer non-critical CSS/JS.

findings.summary: Large amounts of unused JavaScript and CSS ship on primary pages.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse estimated 1,001KiB unused JS on the homepage, 1,335KiB on the article, and 61KiB unused CSS.
findings.suggestedFix: Route-split first-party bundles, conditionally load ad/analytics integrations, and remove unused CSS and legacy code.

findings.summary: Some article links lack accessible names.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse failed link-name on the representative article, and the DOM probe found an empty anchor without text, aria-label, or an image alt.
findings.suggestedFix: Give every interactive link a discernible name and preserve meaningful image alternatives.

findings.summary: Text/background combinations fail minimum contrast.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse failed the color-contrast audit on both homepage and article templates.
findings.suggestedFix: Adjust foreground and background design tokens to meet WCAG AA contrast in every state.

findings.summary: Heading/landmark structure and keyboard focus are not reliable.
findings.evidence: The probe found multiple H1s, hundreds of H2s, no <main>, and focus with outline:none; Lighthouse also reported malformed article list structure.
findings.suggestedFix: Use one page-level H1, a main landmark, valid list semantics, and an obvious :focus-visible treatment in logical order.

findings.summary: The page requests notification permission on load and has platform hygiene failures.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse failed notification-on-start, deprecated APIs, inspector issues and BFCache (five reasons) on the homepage.
findings.suggestedFix: Request notifications only after a user gesture and clear deprecated APIs, inspector issues, and BFCache blockers.

findings.summary: Notification permission is requested at page startup rather than in context.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse failed notification-on-start on both homepage and article. Authentication was not exercised because login is a separate portal.
findings.suggestedFix: Ask for notification permission only after an explicit, relevant user action and explain the value before the browser prompt.

findings.summary: Image delivery wastes bytes across a content-heavy news page.
findings.evidence: Of 100 images, 93 use legacy formats, 63 lack srcset and 26 are oversized; Lighthouse estimates up to 448KiB image savings on the article.
findings.suggestedFix: Generate responsive AVIF/WebP variants, use srcset/sizes, preserve intrinsic dimensions and avoid oversized decorative assets.

findings.summary: Background and third-party work is disproportionate to reading news.
findings.evidence: HAR recorded 39 scripts and 35 third-party origins; trace TBT was 947ms and Lighthouse reported 18.5s main-thread work.
findings.suggestedFix: Do not start optional advertising/analytics work before consent; defer and conditionally load integrations after core content.

findings.summary: Third-party scripts dominate a multi-megabyte page load.
findings.evidence: The homepage transferred 3.59MB across 149 requests, including 1.79MB of scripts and 35 third-party origins.
findings.suggestedFix: Set a third-party byte/request budget, remove low-value vendors, and lazy-load remaining ad/media dependencies.

findings.summary: The site does not adapt to the user’s dark color-scheme preference.
findings.evidence: The dark-mode probe reported colorScheme "normal" and a white body background; the dark screenshot retains the light consent surface and page palette.
findings.suggestedFix: Declare color-scheme and provide preference-driven dark surface/text tokens with prefers-color-scheme or light-dark().

findings.summary: Consent overlays are custom role=dialog structures rather than native dialog primitives.
findings.evidence: The DOM probe found 0 <dialog>, 0 popover, 0 details, and four role=dialog elements.
findings.suggestedFix: Use <dialog> for modal consent flows with native focus containment, Escape behavior, and explicit close/reject actions.

findings.summary: Several interactive targets are too short for reliable touch use.
findings.evidence: The target probe found many navigation links only 15–20px tall, despite successful narrow-viewport reflow.
findings.suggestedFix: Increase the clickable box with padding and spacing while preserving the overflow-free mobile layout.

findings.summary: Primary pages log browser console errors.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse failed errors-in-console on both homepage and article.
findings.suggestedFix: Fix first-party exceptions and failed resource calls; isolate third-party failures so they do not pollute or destabilize the page.

findings.summary: Image dimensions, aspect ratios, and formats are not consistently sound.
findings.evidence: The image audit found 7 missing dimensions, 26 oversized images, 63 without srcset and 93 legacy-format images; Lighthouse found incorrect aspect ratios.
findings.suggestedFix: Set intrinsic width/height, preserve aspect ratio, add responsive sources, and deliver AVIF/WebP where appropriate.

findings.summary: The representative article’s JSON-LD is not parseable as JSON.
findings.evidence: The article probe returned "invalid" for its application/ld+json block, despite correct title, description and canonical signals.
findings.suggestedFix: Emit valid NewsArticle JSON-LD that matches the visible headline, dates, author, image and canonical URL; validate it in CI.

findings.summary: The Turkish language is declared, but physical CSS directions dominate.
findings.evidence: The probe confirmed lang=tr, but found 0 logical-property tokens and 34 physical left/right padding or margin tokens in page HTML/CSS.
findings.suggestedFix: Retain lang=tr and migrate layout rules to margin/padding/inset-inline and block logical properties so bidi layouts can adapt.

findings.summary: Visible date/currency data is not exposed in robust locale-aware semantics.
findings.evidence: Article time elements use non-ISO datetime values such as 19.07.2026 09:44:00, and the currency template exposes locale data without a table structure.
findings.suggestedFix: Format with Intl for tr-TR and expose machine-readable ISO dates and semantic data tables.

findings.summary: Article timestamps are ambiguous about offset and time zone.
findings.evidence: The datetime attributes are local dotted date strings with no UTC offset or IANA zone, so DST/zone interpretation is not deterministic.
findings.suggestedFix: Store unambiguous instants, render with Intl.DateTimeFormat, and use ISO 8601 datetime attributes including an offset.

findings.summary: The homepage has a large initial memory and DOM footprint.
findings.evidence: The baseline heap had 720,065 heap nodes and 39.3MB self size, while the DOM probe counted 13,996 elements for a news listing.
findings.suggestedFix: Virtualize or paginate deep feeds, reduce duplicate hidden markup, and conditionally instantiate consent/ad components.

findings.summary: Page and route changes have no authored View Transitions.
findings.evidence: The active probe found browser support but no authored view-transition usage; navigation remains a hard document swap.
findings.suggestedFix: Add same-document or cross-document View Transitions for primary article and section navigation, with reduced-motion handling.

findings.summary: The long news feed provides no scroll-state progress or responsive chrome.
findings.evidence: The 22,394px homepage has no authored container/scroll-state signal and no visible reading or feed-position cue.
findings.suggestedFix: Use scroll-state-aware sticky chrome or a lightweight declarative progress indicator where it helps orientation.

findings.summary: Navigation does not visibly direct attention after state or route changes.
findings.evidence: The navigation probe found no authored View Transition, scroll marker, or scroll snap behavior on a very long feed.
findings.suggestedFix: Add directional transitions or clear current/target highlighting for route and in-page navigation.

findings.summary: No component-level container-query adaptation was found.
findings.evidence: The active probe found no authored @container usage across reusable news cards and navigation components.
findings.suggestedFix: Introduce container-type and focused @container rules for cards reused in rails, grids, and narrow columns.
